events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. Which track is your go-to? 'While My Guitar Gently Weeps' or 'Helter Skelter'?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their evolution. Still sounds fresh today.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: We remember the visionary musician and songwriter, John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. A musical legend whose legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the iconic David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie 80th Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. Forever a trailblazer in music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Paying tribute to the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Elvis 92nd Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music still gets us all shook up.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! The architect of so many iconic riffs. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking and rolling after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! Still bringing the house down. Our house, in the middle of our street.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the soulful singer, Paul Young.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still the voice of 'Wherever I Lay My Hat'. A true 80s icon.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon and national treasure. What a way to make a living!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That stardom to solo success, still a pop powerhouse.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the Grammy-winning British soul singer, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean! Get out of our dreams and into our cars, it's time to celebrate a true legend.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inauguration
events.blurb: The first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1986, honouring rock pioneers.

angles.name: Rock Hall Turns 41
angles.copy: 41 years since the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first opened its doors to the greats. Who's your essential Hall of Famer?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member, Mark Owen.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming us all since the Take That days.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance, the famous rooftop concert, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Concert 58 Years
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for their legendary final live performance. A moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary drummer and singer-songwriter, Phil Collins.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! Still 'In The Air Tonight' for millions.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to beloved British actor, Hugh Grant.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to dramas, a true British institution.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Justin Timberlake
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! Bringing sexy back since forever. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British actor, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Happy Birthday David Jason
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Day The Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died', 68 years ago. Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper – gone but never forgotten.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the iconic British singer, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! He's never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down. Still a legend!

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the reggae icon, Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: Bob Marley 82nd Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music and message resonate more than ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter, Carole King.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius who gave us so many timeless classics.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, 15 years since we lost her. Her music lives on.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, millions of hearts broke as Take That announced their split.

angles.name: Take That Split 31 Years
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 31 years since Take That announced their split? We're still 'Back For Good' with their music.

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell! The voice behind so many UB40 classics. Red, Red Wine anyone?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Happy 36th birthday to the global superstar singer-songwriter, Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed Sheeran
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to Ed Sheeran! One of the biggest artists on the planet, still making us feel 'Perfect'.
